out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED A SPRAY CAN OF INSECTICIDE IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: INSECTICIDE REMOVED FROM CAFETERIA DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: BeverageAir 2 DR UR on right side of kitchen. Observed temperature at 47F. Temperature logs from last 2 weeks indicate temperatures have been between 40-46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM stated work order was placed. CFM will follow up with work order. EHS recommended storage of only non-TCS foods in unit until able to maintain proper cold holding temperature of 41F or below.
